title: Episode 2 - Chulbul ki topi
end_card:
पार्ट 3 जल्द आ रहा है!
बने रहिए!

shots.visual: Dawn in the market square. Every single diya from the lamp stall has vanished, only empty clay trays remain. On the ground lies a small brown newsboy cap. Chikki holds it up between two fingers with one eyebrow raised. Chulbul stands beside her, staring at the cap with wide eyes, sweating.
shots.camera: slow pan across the empty trays, ending on Chikki holding up the cap

lines.speaker: chikki
lines.hi: एक भी दिया नहीं बचा! और ये टोपी चुलबुल, तेरी है!

lines.speaker: chulbul
lines.hi: मेरी? नहीं! ये मेरी जुड़वाँ टोपी है!

shots.visual: Chikki clips a tiny pair of handcuffs onto Chulbul's tail. Chulbul wriggles and squeaks, tugging at the handcuffs, while Chikki stays completely calm.
shots.camera: medium two-shot, then a close-up on the handcuffs on his tail

shots.visual: Chikki sniffs the cap and turns it over under her magnifying glass: tiny golden shimmering dust sticks to the lining. She looks up, serious. Behind her, out of focus, Chulbul slips out of the handcuffs far too easily and quickly licks a golden crumb off his paw.
shots.camera: extreme close-up on the golden dust under the magnifying glass, then pull back to Chikki

lines.speaker: chikki
lines.hi: टोपी पर सोने की धूल? चोर की नज़र किसी बड़ी चीज़ पर है!

shots.visual: Chikki finds a folded note tucked in the cap lining and unfolds it. The note shows a hand-drawn golden laddoo and a golden paw-print stamp, with no readable writing. Bhola leans in over her shoulder to look. A dramatic close-up of the note, then Bhola faints backward with a thud.
shots.camera: close-up on the note in Chikki's paws, then wide as Bhola faints

lines.speaker: chikki
lines.hi: सोने का लड्डू! अगला निशाना वही है!

shots.visual: Cliffhanger. Kallu the crow alone on a rooftop edge at sunrise. A tiny folded note with a golden paw-print stamp lies at his feet. He looks at it, grins slyly, then gulps the note down like a snack and rubs his wings together slowly, looking down at the village.
